== Acquisition ==
* Talking to [[Kelvei, the Legendary Observer]] after completing [[Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result]].
** The item can be acquired only if the [[Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound]] collection hasn't been unlocked and if the item is not in inventory.

== Notes ==
* Multiple copies can be obtained.
